title: Etale representatives of pro-etale derived Isom sections
statement: For derived module sheaves A,D on an etale scheme, with D bounded below [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], a pro-etale derived Isom presheaf section [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf] between their comparison pullbacks [def-weil-pbc-derived-morphism-sheaf-comparison], carried by an etale neighbourhood of every geometric point, has an actual etale derived-isomorphism representative on such a neighbourhood.

source.place: Tags 09BV and 00WJ; local representatives of Isom presheaf sections.

proof.text: Apply the local-cover theorem with the supplied lower bound on D. Lift the chosen separably closed geometric point through that etale cover using Scheme.Cover.exists_comp_eq_of_isSepClosed, compose its covering morphism with V.hom, and use the isomorphism on that member.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09B1, lemma-compare-derived; bounded-below derived comparison, together with localization and exact pullback.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_local_representative_of_proetale_local_iso_sections
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEt)
    {B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing B]
    (A D : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)))
    (hD : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus D)
    (hsections : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
      (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U.left),
      ∃ (V : U.left.Etale) (v : (pointSmallEtale x).fiber.obj V),
        Nonempty ((derivedLocalIsoPresheaf (ProEt.topology U.left) B
          ((derivedComparison U.left B).obj A)
          ((derivedComparison U.left B).obj D)).obj
            (op ((toProEt U.left).obj V)))) :
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
      (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U.left),
      ∃ (V : U.left.Etale) (v : (pointSmallEtale x).fiber.obj V),
        Nonempty ((localIsomorphismRestriction U.left B V).obj A ≅
          (localIsomorphismRestriction U.left B V).obj D)

statement_change.old_statement: For arbitrary derived module sheaves on an etale scheme, a pro-etale derived Isom presheaf section carried by an etale neighbourhood of every geometric point has an actual etale derived-isomorphism representative on such a neighbourhood.
statement_change.what: The former arbitrary-target statement does not follow from local surjectivity of sheafification: a pro-etale cover cannot in general be refined by an etale cover, and the input is already an actual derived Isom presheaf section. Add the bounded-below target hypothesis needed by the existing derived comparison Hom bijection. The finite-level consumer already assumes D bounded, so its statement is unchanged.

citers.note: The finite-level theorem already assumes hDbounded. Its unchanged conclusion follows after extracting D.IsGE a and passing that bound to the repaired intermediate theorem.

old_proof.text: Apply the local-cover representative theorem to the supplied pro-etale section over an etale object V. The existing geometric-point lifting theorem for an etale cover lifts the chosen separably closed geometric point to one cover member. Compose the lifted point with V to obtain the required pointed etale object and use the local isomorphism on that member.
